The '''CZR-9001 assault cannon''' was a model of [[Assault cannon/Legends|assault cannon]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CZR-9001 assault cannon first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an item that required reputation to purchase at [[CZ-198]]. Several iterations of it feature different stats.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
